property_summary: For every call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly later block timestamp, the correct contract retains its balance unless block.number % 15 == 0 (only then it pays out); the mutant flips the payout condition and will sometimes pay out when block.number % 15 != 0, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the transfer condition to trigger when block.number % 15 != 0, altering when the contract pays out its balance.
